title: Longest Consecutive Run
commonMistakes: Counting duplicate values as separate steps in a run
Expanding a run from every value, which can degrade to quadratic time
Sorting the input but forgetting that duplicates must collapse
Returning a run's ending value instead of its length
followUps: How would you return the actual values in the longest run?
Can you solve it in O(n log n) without a hash set, and what is the trade-off?
How would you maintain the answer as values are inserted one at a time?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
